title.narrative: Praise Export Services Limited and Queen's University of Belfast

description.narrative: Development of a novel, rapid, non-destructive, handheld test to determine integrity and quality of red palm oil and palm cream concentrate. Innovation area – Food integrity/authenticity The KTP plan will deliver two tests, one to rapidly measure/validate the quality of palm oil and the other to check for Sudan dye adulteration. It will develop, validate and implement novel techniques that are rapid, low cost and reliable, using vibrational spectroscopy. The Institute for Global Food Security are world-leading experts in such techniques and will work alongside researchers in Cape Coast University to successfully deliver the project. The outcome will be an industry based Quality Assurance Scheme that will be recognised by the government in Ghana and customers that import Ghanaian palm oil. ODA – KTP will deliver benefit the company’s profitability, but also will benefit the entire workforce, providing opportunities for upskilling and training in new processing and analytical techniques. The KTP will have far reaching benefits across the local community. Livelihoods will be significantly improved in the farming communities particularly for women who constitute about 80% of the workforce, and who are employed along the value chain to strip the fruits for production of oil. There will also be opportunities to increase the workforce involved in the production of the oil due to the increased demand by the coming on board of the rapid test. We anticipate that the assurance received by global customers of the quality of Palm oil by this innovative technology would eventually double or triple the already huge demand for the product thereby resulting in the employment of more women on the farms and at the oil mills. Oil Palm Farmers and mill operators who do not receive their monies for supplies made to aggregators under the pretext that the oils failed the Sudan dyes test and for that matter could not be sold, would now be able to authenticate their oils right on the farm or at the mills almost instantly without the usual delays for third party testing and then receive their pay, helping to improve the livelihoods of the farmer, their families and other dependants.
